name: Rogers Electrical Contracting
old_description: Rogers Electrical is an electrical contracting company the specializes in Turn-Key electrical projects for various industrial and commercial customers. We have the team, tools, equipment and experience needed to be a viable asset to design and/or build a complete electrical system for any project. We work hard with our customers to achieve the goals that they have in mind and we can give ideas/advice to possible make an even better outcome.
about:
Rogers Electrical Contracting Company, Inc. was founded in 1996 and is headquartered in Fairmont, West Virginia. The firm operates additional divisions in Pennsylvania, Illinois, and North Carolina to serve industrial and commercial customers across the region.

The company provides turnkey electrical contracting services encompassing engineering and design, power line and substation construction, system automation and PLC/SCADA integration, control panel fabrication, fiber optic installation and testing, commercial electrical systems, and bore hole cable services for mining applications. Its in-house professional engineer and design team use CAD, ETAP, and PLS-CADD software to produce detailed project renderings, while an extensive equipment fleet enables work at remote job sites.

Rogers Electrical serves the aggregate, oil and gas, coal, water, and electric utility industries, as well as commercial construction. Notable projects include a turnkey upgrade of a coal preparation plant in Philippi, WV, involving electrical design, installation, programming, and start-up, and the design and build of a 50 MVA 138-34.5 kV substation for a mine power system in the same area.

The firm emphasizes its more than three decades of industry experience and a commitment to going the extra mile for quality. Its service model combines complete plant builds, plant upgrades, overland conveyor systems, motor control centers, and PLC programming under a single turnkey umbrella, aiming to make projects efficient and cost-effective.

name: Ron's Home Style Foods
old_description: At Rons Foods, we make our products fresh daily under USDA and FDA inspection with the highest quality ingredients and processes to ensure a homemade look and taste. The production facility exceeds all food safety expectations. Our attention to detail extends beyond what can be seen and tasted.
about:
Ron's Home Style Foods was founded in the spring of 1985 by Ron Woodall in Houston, Texas. The family-owned company began with a mission to produce high-quality, home-style deli salads that look and taste homemade. Woodall had previously developed the successful Ron's Krispy Fried Chicken chain before launching the venture.

Today the company operates a USDA- and FDA-inspected production facility where it makes deli salads, dips and spreads, dressings and bases, gourmet burger kits, frozen sides and entrees, and provides co-packing and private-label services. Products are prepared fresh daily using high-quality ingredients, and the facility is described as exceeding food-safety expectations.

Ron's serves the foodservice and grocery channels nationwide. Its retail line, Texas Kitchen, is stocked in major Texas chains including Brookshire Brothers, H-E-B, and Kroger. The company also partners with foodservice distributors and recently announced a collaboration with Center of the Plate Foods Sales to accelerate national growth.

The business emphasizes a homemade look and taste, with attention to detail that extends beyond what can be seen and tasted. Its founding goal remains the benchmark: delivering products that meet global food-safety standards while satisfying customer expectations for quality and consistency.

name: Rooftop Power
old_description: Rooftop Power is a family-owned solar and roofing company headquartered on West Natick Road in Warwick, Rhode Island, founded in 2017. We are dedicated to helping homeowners across Rhode Island, Massachusetts and Connecticut cut their monthly electric bills and build a more sustainable future.
about:
Rooftop Power is a family-owned solar and roofing company headquartered in Warwick, Rhode Island, founded in 2017. The business began with a focus on helping homeowners across Rhode Island, Massachusetts, and Connecticut reduce their electric bills through rooftop solar.

The company installs custom residential and commercial solar arrays, integrates battery storage, standby generators, and EV chargers, and provides roofing replacement and repair—all performed by its own electricians, roofers, and installers.

Its customers are primarily single-family homeowners and commercial building owners in Rhode Island, Massachusetts, and Connecticut who want to lower energy costs, gain backup power, or combine a roof replacement with solar. The firm also services orphaned systems originally installed by other contractors.

Rooftop Power was built to eliminate the coordination gaps that arise when solar, roofing, and electrical work are split among multiple contractors. It offers a single workmanship warranty covering both roof and array, one project manager and schedule, and a single point of contact for service calls years after installation.

name: Rooftop Solar
old_description: Hadassah’s long-held belief that everyone has the right to a healthy environment and a bright future led to her pursuit of a degree in Urban and Environmental Planning. She has dedicated her professional career to helping to create a sustainable energy future, beginning as manager of a land management collaborative of more than 425,000 acres. After developing the skills to run a dynamic solar installation company, Hadassah co-founded Rooftop Solar and serves as its COO. As one of Rooftop’s leaders, Hadassah is able to help to make change at the local level working with a group of colleagues she respects and enjoys.
about:
Rooftop Solar is based in Phoenix, Arizona, and was founded in 1979. The company was co-founded by Hadassah, who serves as its chief operating officer. Hadassah’s background in urban and environmental planning included managing a land conservation collaborative spanning more than 425,000 acres before she developed the expertise to launch a solar installation business.

The firm designs and installs custom photovoltaic systems for homes and businesses across the Phoenix metropolitan area, including Anthem, Cave Creek, Mesa, Chandler, Goodyear, Glendale, and Scottsdale. It partners exclusively with manufacturers such as REC, LG, Panasonic, Hanwha, Solaria, Enphase, SolarEdge, and Tesla Powerwall for modules, inverters, and storage. Rooftop Solar holds NABCEP certification along with Arizona electrical and dual building contractor licenses, and it backs every installation with a third-party 30-year warranty covering equipment, roofing, and labor. Financing is arranged through credit-union partnerships that eliminate dealer fees.

Customers range from individual homeowners to schools, churches, hospitals, historic buildings, multifamily housing, hotels, and office towers. Commercial projects include solar carports, parking canopies, rooftop arrays, and ground-mount systems. The company also assists clients with tax incentives, rebates, and accelerated depreciation strategies.

Hadassah’s founding vision was rooted in the belief that everyone deserves a healthy environment and a bright energy future. Rooftop Solar emphasizes a low-pressure, educational sales approach and a customer experience that extends throughout the system’s lifespan, supported by a dedicated service department.

name: Rooted Furniture
old_description: Great furniture begins with great lumber. We never use plywood or veneer. Each piece is built using sustainably-harvested North American oak. Each board is hand-selected to ensure the highest quality. We also make it a priority to support responsible forestry with FSC® certified, ECC, CARB and LEED compliant wood.
about:
Rooted Furniture operates from a workshop in Boulder, Colorado, where it designs and builds custom solid-wood furniture. The company was established to create heirloom-quality pieces using only sustainably harvested North American hardwoods, avoiding plywood and veneer entirely.

Each piece is handcrafted from domestically sourced species such as white oak, black walnut, hard maple, and cherry. The shop employs traditional joinery techniques — mortise and tenon, dovetail, and tongue and groove — and finishes every surface with a plant-based, non-toxic oil that is food-safe and VOC-free. Projects typically move from consultation to delivery in eight to fourteen weeks, depending on complexity.

Rooted serves residential clients across the Front Range and ships nationwide via white-glove freight carriers. Its portfolio includes dining tables, benches, rocking chairs, cutting boards, and occasional tables for both private homes and office settings. The company also works with interior designers and architects on custom commissions.

A core differentiator is the Planting Roots initiative, which plants a tree through the National Forest Foundation for every table sold. The business emphasizes responsible forestry, using FSC-certified, ECC, CARB, and LEED-compliant lumber, and invites customers to visit its Boulder workshop by appointment.

name: Rosebud Wood Products
old_description: Rosebud Wood Products has been in the kitchen and bath cabinetry industry since 1965, producing semi-custom and custom cabinetry for the home.  Many of their employees have been with them for 35-40 years. Their experience and cabinet knowledge has given them a solid foundation to build and grow their business over the years. In 1985, Rosebud expanded into the hospitality furniture industry.
about:
Rosebud Wood Products was founded in 1965 in Madison, South Dakota, as a family-owned cabinetry shop. The company began producing semi-custom and custom kitchen and bath cabinetry for residential customers, building a reputation for quality craftsmanship.

Today the firm operates a 62,000-square-foot manufacturing facility in Madison, where it produces a range of cabinetry lines including the Supreme and Traditional series, multi-family SMART cabinetry, commercial casework, hospitality furniture, and closet systems. The workforce includes multiple generations of employees, many with decades of tenure, though the company does not disclose an exact headcount.

Rosebud serves residential, commercial, multifamily, and hospitality markets across the Midwest and beyond, with showrooms in Madison, the Sioux Falls area, and Dickinson, North Dakota. Its customer base includes homeowners, designers, builders, and hospitality operators seeking tailored wood products for kitchens, baths, offices, entertainment centers, fireplaces, and closets.

The company emphasizes flexibility, offering made-to-order modifications to its standard cabinet lines and providing free design services using current cabinet design software. Its culture centers on combining innovative processes with the experience of long-tenured employees, reflecting a belief that quality pays rather than costs.

name: Route 66 Controls LLC
old_description: Fast delivery of electrical/mechanical R&D designs, simulations, finite element analysis, and prototypes of your ideas.  We have a group of top PhD design engineers.  Consider us your remote R&D.  Since 2005, we have designed, developed, and transferred dozens of high-tech power converter systems including motor drives, dc/dc, inverters, industrial UPS systems, battery chargers, automotive traction drives, and aerospace ground support and onboard chargers/drives.  Some of which you might have had interactions with.
about:
Route 66 Controls LLC was founded in 2005 in Cuba, Missouri, by Dr. Pourya Shamsi, who serves as CEO and lead design engineer. The company is structured as a design-engineer-owned firm, with its principal engineers holding ownership stakes, a model the firm says keeps overhead low and aligns incentives with project outcomes.

The firm provides end-to-end R&D for power electronics and motor drives, covering electrical and mechanical design, finite-element simulation, embedded software development, prototyping, and testing. Its engineers work with tools such as Altium, Ansys, Matlab, and SolidWorks to deliver custom converters up to 2 MW, 2,000 A, and 12 kV, and can prototype systems up to 5 MW at IP68 ratings. In-house test capacity reaches 500 kW for converters and 300 kW for drives, supplemented by a local machining partner for larger mechanical structures. The company produces hundreds of prototypes annually but does not pursue high-volume manufacturing.

Customers span aerospace (ground-support and onboard chargers), automotive (traction drives), industrial UPS, and emerging airship and eVTOL platforms. A noted reference project is the energy-management and battery-charger system powering LTA's airship. The firm also serves startups needing low-cost prototypes for fundraising and established OEMs seeking manufacturing-ready designs for certification.

Route 66 Controls differentiates itself through full intellectual-property transfer — including design files, code, patents, and training — under NDA protection. Its PhD-level engineers, many of whom hold university faculty positions, bring federally funded research experience (NSF, DOE, DoD) to commercial projects, targeting delivery within three to six months.

name: Rubix Foods
old_description: The NEXT Flavor Report is a first-of-its-kind compilation of third-party market research and proprietary data gathered by the Rubix Foods NEXT Flavor Network – a collective of influential taste-making social media creators with Gen Z audiences – who have helped us unveil the unfiltered, unbiased and real-time cravings of this highly sought after generation who will reshape the flavor trends and strategies of restaurant menus in 2025.
about:
Rubix Foods traces its roots to Jacksonville, Florida, where Aaron Block and Aaron Lapin co-founded Reddi-Wip in 1948. The business evolved through the Block family for five generations, with Mickey Block building the first U.S. ultra-high-temperature dairy plant in 1965. Darifair Foods was established in 1981 as the first national dairy supplier, becoming the nation’s largest producer of portion-controlled private-label sour cream by the 1990s. In 2021 the company rebranded as Rubix Foods, expanding beyond dairy into end-to-end product development under continued family ownership.

Today Rubix operates as a full-service product development house with end-to-end manufacturing capabilities. Its 50,000-square-foot Innovation Center, opened in 2022 and FDA-registered in 2024, houses R&D, culinary, and production under one roof. Core platforms include compound butter systems, sauces and glazes, dips/spreads/fillings, performance blends, marination systems, aerosol systems, cultured dairy (sour creams, yogurts), and dairy essentials such as milk, buttermilk, and cream. The facility supports custom formulation from concept through commercialization.

The company serves foodservice chains and high-momentum brands, providing private-label and co-manufactured products for national accounts. Historical customers include quick-service and casual-dining operators that rely on Rubix for portion-controlled sour cream, clean-label cream alternatives, and custom marination blends for proteins and vegetables.

Rubix positions itself on speed, quality, and reliability, aiming to be the industry’s first call for solving tough formulation challenges. Its NEXT Flavor Network leverages Gen Z social-media creators to deliver real-time consumer insights, while a disciplined “velocity to market” approach compresses development timelines without sacrificing execution.

name: Ryco Manufacturing, LLC dba Ryone Manufacturing Company
old_description: The Ryone family has been manufacturing precision cutting tools for the metal and plastic industry since 1972. Originally founded by Arthur “Garfield” Ryone, the business continues to be run by the Ryone family and has a combined 100 years of experience. The business has now grown to offer full regrind services, roll grinding, and machine shop services.
about:
Ryone Manufacturing Company, based in North Providence, Rhode Island, has been producing precision cutting tools since 1972. The company was founded by Arthur "Garfield" Ryone and remains under family ownership, with the Ryone family collectively bringing over 100 years of experience to the operation.

The shop specializes in regrinding and roll grinding services, handling roll grinding up to 20-inch diameter and 80-inch length, and offers a full range of machine shop capabilities. These include CNC turning with live tooling up to 12 inches, CNC vertical milling up to 18 by 36 inches, OD grinding up to 20-inch diameter, rotary grinding up to 16-inch diameter, and turning up to 22-inch diameter. The company also manufactures custom saw blades, slitting knives, and special shank tools in both steel and carbide, and provides full re-sharpening services for those materials.

Ryone serves the metal and plastic industries, supplying cutting tools and machined components to customers who require precision grinding and custom tooling. The business works from customer prints for custom parts and caters to orders for regrinding and resharpening of existing tools.

The company emphasizes its combined 100 years of family experience and the breadth of its in-house grinding and machining capabilities as key differentiators, allowing it to handle both standard regrinding jobs and complex custom tool manufacturing under one roof.

name: S E International Inc
old_description: SE International has been a trusted radiation detector manufacturer and supplier since 1979. Here’s why radiation safety professionals, labs, hospitals, industrial facilities, and government agencies choose Radiation Alert®:
about:
S.E. International, Inc. (SEI) was founded in 1979 in Summertown, Tennessee. The company began with the Monitor 4, a durable and affordable general-purpose Geiger counter that established a reputation for reliability in radiation survey meters.

SEI designs, manufactures, and services the Radiation Alert® line of radiation detection instruments, including handheld detectors, area monitors, dosimeters, survey meters, portal monitors, and multichannel analyzers. All products are built and serviced at the Summertown facility, and the company also provides calibration services and free PC-based and Android monitoring software. Radiation Alert® instruments are distributed in over 100 countries through a global distributor network.

The company serves radiation safety professionals, laboratories, hospitals, industrial facilities, and government agencies across sectors such as government and security, healthcare, industry and manufacturing, laboratories and education, nuclear and health physics, and public safety.

SEI emphasizes honesty, innovation, and dependable technology, with a mission to deliver high-quality equipment that fits a wide range of budgets while keeping safety at the core. The company supports local nonprofits through development grants and donations, and has received statewide recognition in Tennessee for international sales achievements and customer support.
